name: Daily Euro Dollar Exchange Rate
citation: Yahoo Finance. "EUR/USD (EURUSD=X) Historical Data." Yahoo Finance, 2026, finance.yahoo.com/quote/EURUSD=X. Covariates: CBOE Volatility Index (^VIX), Brent crude front-month (BZ=F), CBOE 10-Year Treasury Yield index (^TNX).
license: Market data via Yahoo Finance, for research/benchmark use.
description:
Daily EUR/USD spot exchange rate (mid quote) with market covariates: the CBOE Volatility Index (VIX, risk sentiment), Brent crude oil, and the US 10-year Treasury yield. Target is near-random-walk (Meese-Rogoff); covariate value is limited at short horizons. Application: FX desk hedging and exposure planning.

Covariate glossary:
- eurusd: EUR/USD spot exchange rate, US dollars per euro (target).
- vix: CBOE Volatility Index, 30-day implied volatility of S&P 500 options, index points (risk sentiment).
- brent: Brent crude oil front-month price, USD per barrel.
- ust10y: US 10-year Treasury constant-maturity yield, percent per annum.
preprocessing: 1. Downloaded from the cited public source (Yahoo Finance) on 2026-07-14.
2. Aligned all variates onto a single shared time index; covariates forward-filled where a release lag left a gap.
3. Long TempusBench layout: one row per variate; a single shared 'timestamps' JSON array of ISO-8601 UTC strings; 'values' a JSON array (missing -> null).
4. Calendar/derived features (week-of-year, holiday flags) are NOT included as columns; a single time index is provided and models derive calendar features from it.
